title: Google Launches Free ‘Skilling Africa’ Hub With Offline Lessons and AI Study Companion
description: Google has launched Skilling Africa with Google, a free learning hub that brings more than 15 of its digital and AI training programmes into one place and is built to work on entry-level phones and limited data. title: SNP urged to give Scots a referendum on AI data centres after US 'earthquake'
description: SCOTS should be given a say on AI data centres being built in their communities after a “political earthquake” in the US midterms where voters overwhelmingly rejected the energy-hungry developments.

title: AI Task Forces Drive Policy, Adoption and Innovation in Higher Ed
description: Artificial intelligence is arriving on campuses faster than governance can keep up. Individual departments and staff members are trying out new tools without the input of IT, leading to creeping shadow AI. Students with the means to access frontier AI models may have an advantage over students who use free versions of AI tools due to limited resources. And faculty are struggling to maintain standards of academic integrity without becoming detectives whose full-time job is hunting down “AI slop.” A number of colleges and universities have created cross-functional AI committees,…
